TX.anchors: THE TEXAS SECRETARY OF STATE WILL BE CLOSED TUESDAY, JANUARY 21, DUE TO INCLEMENT WEATHER. THE OFFICE OF TEXAS SECRETARY OF STATE WILL BE CLOSED TUESDAY, JANUARY 27, DUE TO INCLEMENT WEATHER. ONLINE SERVICES REMAIN AVAILABLE 24/7. Maintenance Notice: SOSPortal applications including Business Filings, Notary and Texas Register will be unavailable from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. from Tuesday, September 29, through Friday, October 2 Early voting for the November 3 Election runs Oct. 19-30. Last day for applications for ballot by mail to be received Oct. 23. IN-PERSON SERVICES FOR THE OFFICE OF THE TEXAS SECRETARY OF STATE HAVE MOVED TO 400 W. 15TH STREET. PARKING DETAILS AND MORE INFORMATION Candidates seeking to file applications outside of lobby hours should contact the Elections Division at 512-463-5650.
